content.change_type: clarification of ambiguous wording; no detector, threshold rule or hypothesis changed

clarifications.fold_column_identity: Column lists stay frozen (71 primary; 35/36 dual; 8 loss-only) in every fold. Fold refit = link_stats for agg.rate_absz_* and min/max bounds on fold-train. select_features is NOT re-run to change columns; a column constant on fold-train keeps bounds [c,c]. Per-fold count of such columns is reported as diagnostic.
clarifications.why: K must be comparable with the final 71-column detector; per-fold column sets would change the scale of k.
clarifications.h4_envelope_rate: share of JUDGEABLE held-out rows with primary k>0, per fold, uncalibrated.
clarifications.two_stage_execution: Stage cv writes phase6_envelope_cv.json from train only; it is committed before stage test may run; stage test refuses if CV file, detector code or registrations are uncommitted, modified, or if results exist.

content.known_risk_declared_before_cv: Under iid noise a new point falls outside the min/max of n fit points with probability 2/(n+1). Low-end folds may therefore show k>0 without extrapolation in load; H4 stays unchanged and may be refuted.
